sources.source_role: Peer-reviewed human observational tissue/multiomic reference; no ex-utero support demonstration
sources.interval_conventions: Abstract describes 3-8 post-conception weeks; integrated reference in Rationale describes 4-8 PCW/CS10-23. Preserve distinct source scopes and modalities pending review.
sources.pairing_scope: E-MTAB-10552 maps source-labeled tissue strata within F61/F79/F80 at CS18. E-MTAB-10888 includes yolk-sac records labeled F79 at CS18 and F80 at CS15; exact sample, BioSample and run IDs do not overlap E-MTAB-10552, and its F80 stage label conflicts with CS18 there. E-MTAB-11673 maps yolk-sac/stalk samples to female F158 at CS17. Its matched coronal accession is now identified as the ENA project submitted under E-MTAB-11911 (PRJEB53919; ERP138734). Public sample metadata show 48 sample/run records across 12 coronal-section labels (four records per section), all labeled F158, female and CS17; these are metadata records from one source-labeled embryo, not 48 embryos or demonstrated independent replicates. E-MTAB-11549/11618/11613 are CITE-seq yolk-sac/liver records with other source-individual labels. Source labels and file/run relationships do not establish cell-level pairing, longitudinal developmental continuity, directional transport, or a machine-supported function relay.
sources.repository_qualification: Official BioStudies API/SDRF metadata are mapped for all six accessions listed by the paper. Full sample crosswalks cover E-MTAB-10552 (22 records), E-MTAB-11673 (6 records in 18 file rows), and E-MTAB-10888 (142 records in 284 paired-end file rows); a sample-level CITE-seq crosswalk covers E-MTAB-11549 (2 ENA samples/96 runs/288 rows), E-MTAB-11618 (3/144/430), and E-MTAB-11613 (6/288/864). The last three BioStudies descriptions report 2, 3 and 6 biological replicates respectively; these source claims are kept separate from sample, run and file-row counts. The E-MTAB-11673 matched coronal-section accession is identified through the reciprocal public description and ENA/NCBI metadata as E-MTAB-11911 (PRJEB53919; ERP138734). Its 48 ENA sample/BioSample/run records resolve to 12 section labels, four records per section, all F158/female/CS17. No raw reads or processed expression matrices were downloaded or analyzed. BioStudies exact-term search results alone did not surface the matched project; a missing search hit is not evidence of absence. The matched project file screen maps 48 runs to 144 submitted FASTQ files (I1/R1/R2), but the requested ENA analysis-file report is empty; although the project description says combined CellRanger count matrices are attached, no direct matrix manifest or per-section partition was identified. A 2026 bioRxiv preprint independently lists E-MTAB-11911 for F158 raw FASTQ/count data while reporting that its accessions and portal are private pending publication; current ENA run metadata is public, but no count-matrix file listing was found, so processed-data access is unresolved.

coronal_section_accession_search.target: Find the matched coronal-section accession for source-labeled F158/HDBR sample 16099, mentioned without an accession number in E-MTAB-11673.
coronal_section_accession_search.method: Search the official BioStudies API across all collections and the ArrayExpress collection for F158, 16099, and the exact phrase "coronal section". Retrieve ENA Browser API XML for the known E-MTAB-11673 project and its six sample/run pairs. After exact search did not surface the matched dataset, inspect the official NCBI BioProject record PRJEB53919 and its ENA project/sample metadata; compare the reciprocal project descriptions and sample-level individual, stage, sex, and sampling-site attributes.
coronal_section_accession_search.result: The matched coronal-section accession is identified as E-MTAB-11911, ENA project PRJEB53919 (secondary study ERP138734). Reciprocal public descriptions identify the same F158/HDBR 16099 embryo and the yolk-sac/coronal accession relationship. Public metadata map 48 unique ENA sample/BioSample/experiment/run records to 12 coronal section labels, four records per section, all source-labeled F158, female, Carnegie stage 17. The ENA run-file report maps each run to three submitted FASTQ files (I1/R1/R2), 144 files total. The project description reports combined CellRanger count-matrix files, but the queried ENA analysis-file report has no rows and the project XML exposes no matrix filename or per-section matrix manifest. This is a metadata/file-index screen only; no sequence or matrix files were downloaded, and no global absence claim is made. A 2026 bioRxiv v2 preprint independently lists E-MTAB-11911 as the F158 scRNA-seq raw FASTQ/count accession, but states its data and portal are private pending publication. Current ENA metadata exposes raw run/file listings but no matrix file manifest, creating an archive/status discrepancy; count-matrix access remains unverified.
coronal_section_accession_search.ena_search_qualification: ENA Portal API global sample/search-field calls returned HTTP 500 and unfielded read_run searches returned HTTP 400; the project-level filereport attempt also returned HTTP 500. Direct ENA Browser XML lookup by known project/sample/run accession succeeded and confirms only the six already mapped yolk-sac records. These limited direct lookups do not identify another accession; do not infer global absence from ENA search failures.

contemporary_atlas_preprint_crosscheck.source_type: bioRxiv preprint; not treated as peer-reviewed evidence
contemporary_atlas_preprint_crosscheck.title: An integrated single cell and spatial omics atlas of human prenatal development
contemporary_atlas_preprint_crosscheck.cross_reference_result: The v2 preprint lists E-MTAB-11911 as the scRNA-seq raw FASTQ and count-data accession for whole embryo F158. ENA project PRJEB53919 uses E-MTAB-11911 as its submitter alias and carries the same F158/HDBR 16099 embryo title, confirming that the preprint and project refer to the same accession.
contemporary_atlas_preprint_crosscheck.preprint_data_availability_claim: The retrieved v2 text says all listed whole-embryo data accessions are currently private pending publication; it lists E-MTAB-11911 for F158 raw FASTQ and counts and says an atlas portal will provide raw/processed matrices and metadata but is currently password protected.
contemporary_atlas_preprint_crosscheck.current_repository_comparison: As of 2026-10-11, the public ENA/NCBI raw-read records and the BioStudies study-detail endpoint show different access states. E-MTAB-11504 resolves to public ENA project PRJEB51328 / ERP135952 with 45 public SRA run records; ENA sample metadata maps these records to all 12 F137 coronal labels, with one record for section one and four for each remaining section. NCBI RunInfo provides 45 run-level archive records but not FASTQ file links; ENA filereport requests timed out for both the study and one run. E-MTAB-11911 resolves to public PRJEB53919 / ERP138734 with 48 public sample/run records and 144 FASTQs; its description likewise says F158 filtered matrices are attached. In contrast, anonymous BioStudies API requests for all six accessions named by the preprint returned HTTP 403 with 'Study not accessible'. This is consistent with the preprint referring to inaccessible ArrayExpress/BioStudies and BioImage Archive study packages while linked ENA raw-read metadata is public, but the endpoint does not expose the cause or release state. Exact matrix download links and per-section matrix partitioning were not independently verified. Exact-term SRA searches returning no E-MTAB-11520 or E-MTAB-14785 matches and a rate-limited E-MTAB-16757 search do not establish cross-archive privacy.
